metadata.title: Identity Lifecycle

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Institutional capability governing the creation, modification, suspension, revocation, and termination of identities.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Authoritative lifecycle management with event-driven provisioning and deprovisioning.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Digital Identity subject to lifecycle operations.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Human or non-human subject associated with an identity.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Identity lifecycle state changes invalidate prior proofing and assurance consistent with SP 800-63B guidance on maintaining and revoking identity confidence.

metadata.remarks:
Identity Lifecycle defines how identities are created, modified, suspended, revoked, and terminated throughout their institutional existence. Lifecycle management ensures access remains aligned with current affiliation, role, and risk.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, and assurance related to identity lifecycle management. Identity semantics are defined by Identity Core; lifecycle governs temporal validity.

components.title: Onboarding
components.description: Controlled creation and initial activation of identities, including assignment of attributes and baseline access.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Creation of accounts with inappropriate initial permissions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Establish identities as part of onboarding.
Create accounts according to account management procedures.

components.title: Changes in Status
components.description: Updates to identity attributes and access triggered by role, affiliation, or status changes.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Privilege persistence following unnoticed or delayed status changes.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Automated entitlement updates aligned with status changes.

components.title: Suspension and Revocation
components.description: Temporary or permanent disabling of identities in response to risk, policy, or separation events.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Continued access by identities that should be suspended.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Rapid suspension or revocation of access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Restrict access dynamically based on status.

components.title: Deprovisioning
components.description: Permanent removal of identities and associated access following end of affiliation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Failure to remove accounts leading to lingering access.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Timely and complete removal of identity access.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Remove accounts when no longer required.
Terminate identity records per lifecycle policy.
